system.summary: Symbol cipher with two to four homophones per letter, double-letter signs, a small sign nomenclature and plain-letter code words and nulls (Tomokiyo's Vulcob-Ancel cipher, 1575-1584).

diacritics.note: Bars and dots distinguish signs (4 with crossed stem = a, Λ with a dot = pp, q with crossbar = ff).

system.sibling_key: Tomokiyo: Vulcob to the Queen Mother, 2 Aug 1572 (BnF fr. 18989) uses the same cipher; Lasry's 1573 Charles IX-Vulcob key (BnF fr. 3318) shares 14 letter forms with a key in this volume.
system.notes: Code words are written in plain letters inside the cipher (saturnus = l'Empereur, Juno = le Roy d'Espagne, my = qu'il), mixed with plain-letter nulls.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo published the key (frencheastern.htm, 15 Mar 2026) and listed the letters but gave no readings; Fontvieille 2024 and Labouchere 1923 do not reach these passages (contributor's prior check, 20 Oct 2026). DECODE has no Colbert 398 record.

conditions.human_role: Contributed: Harumi-Matsuba's work, done by AI (Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5, OpenAI Codex); a person chose the target and decided to publish. This project (Claude, directed by Daniel Bourdeau) only fetched, re-measured and spot-checked it.

solution.what: Contributor: Tomokiyo's Vulcob-Ancel table (frencheastern.htm) rewritten in symbol names (contributed/key.tsv, vk.py TOKENS).
Contributor: every page of Colbert 398 in Tomokiyo's list viewed on the BnF IIIF images; pp. 525-526, 539, 561-563, 565 found to lack a contemporary decipherment.
Contributor: first transcription in symbol names (Claude Sonnet 5.5; p. 539 Opus 5.5), Codex cross-check from line images, two rounds of AI image adjudication; 15 image changes reverted by context.
Contributor: additions to the key from context and the p. 33 margin (uu, g, ff, nn, null c).
Contributor: key applied (vk.py decode), word division by Claude Opus 5.5 (READING.en.md: 27 lines read as is, 69 with one or two context corrections, 29 conjectural).
Contributor: 1,000 shuffled keys scored with a wordfreq French trigram model: 0/1,000 at or above the real key on every read page (p. 570: 4/1,000).
Contributor: three independent Codex transcriptions after the transcription was fixed: value agreement 95.2-96.1% over seven pages, lowest page 88.8% (p. 565).
Contributor: blind calibration on p. 258 and p. 285 (margin decipherments): 85.9% letter agreement against a five-reader majority margin reading (81.8% against one adjudicated reading).

Contributor: code words checked against margin decipherments: saturnus = l'Empereur (p. 258), Juno = le Roy d'Espagne (p. 440), my = qu'il (p. 321), my3θ = qu'ilz; p. 570 found deciphered in the p. 569 margin.
Contributor: prior-work search by a separate Claude reader (Cryptiana, cyphersolver, GitHub, Labouchere 1923, Fontvieille 2024 report, HistoCrypt 2026): nothing found.

Here: measure.py re-measured the seven pages: 4,385 tokens, 98.4% given a value; fr-1530-despatches per char -1.81 to -2.29 against -6.26 to -6.62 for shuffled keys; 95.4% of tokens inside dictionary words after DP segmentation (shuffled keys 50.0%).
Here: calibration recomputed with the contributor's calib.py on their files: 472/556 = 84.9% (reported 85.9%).
Here: spot-check on BnF IIIF 2400 px images, p. 525 l. 9-10 and p. 565 l. 5: 126 signs, sequence and count agree; two i/n choices on p. 525 l. 9 not separable at this resolution.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked Harumi-Matsuba's contributed/transcription/p*.txt, contributed/decoded/p*.txt (unsegmented key output) and contributed/READING.en.md (word-divided reading of all passages), with the contributor's key.tsv (Tomokiyo's table plus additions).

v3 verification: the four contributed-reading entries were scored on the table file READING.en.md / raw decoded page (0.178-0.2). The reading column put into running text (research/reading_audit/v3a_ancel_write.py -> texts/<doc>_reading.md): explicit-hole 0.857 (p525-526), 0.75 (p539, p561-563, p565); plain 0.79/0.75/0.68/0.58. All four keep read; reading fields added.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo published the key for these letters (Cryptiana frencheastern.htm, 'will allow reading undeciphered letters'); the contributor transcribed the passages and applied it, with small additions checked on the volume's margin decipherments.
outcome.fraction_read_source: measure.txt (measure.py): symbols with a key value plus margin-checked code words, over all cipher tokens (symbols and plain-letter groups) of the seven pages, 4,316/4,385.
outcome.notes: A contributed AI-only reading: no human checked the transcription. 0.954 is a lenient dictionary-coverage measure (shuffled keys reach 0.500) and the contributor marks 29 of 125 lines conjectural, so the read bar is not taken as met; documents stay 'read in part' until an eye check.

texts.label: 22 Oct 1577, pp. 524 end-526
texts.summary: Ancel on Archduke Matthias's flight to the Low Countries: he thinks the Emperor [saturnus] will deny any part in it, since the young prince could hardly step out of his room without his brother's leave or leave the castle, shut at night (contributor's summary).

reading_review.note: v3 verification 23 Oct 2026: the sweep scored the contributed table (contributed/READING.en.md, key output and reading columns together, 0.178) or the raw key output, a false alarm. The contributor's reading column, put into running text in texts/p525-526_reading.md (probable nulls dropped, code words confirmed by margin decipherments written as resolved codes, supplied letters bracketed as holes), scores 0.857 explicit-hole (24/28 sentences; plain 0.786); sentences hold. Rests on the contributed reading with Tomokiyo's key; not checked by a human against the images (contributed/OPEN.en.md section 5).
